overall_strategy: Thor is a 12-month-old, 50-lb, high-activity Pitbull with strong chewing drive and access to a large yard. Given the early journey stage and no order history, we prioritize reliable consumables on autoship (main daily food, training treats, poop bags, wipes, dental paste and joint supplements, and pheromone refills) with cadence calculated from Thor’s expected monthly use so you don’t run out during active training/heat events. One-time purchases focus on urgent seasonal needs (water fountain, cooling pad, pool) and durable safety/enrichment items (heavy-duty leashes, chew-proof bed, toys, puzzle feeders, first-aid kit) — items that set up a safe, stimulating environment and last months to years. This mix ensures Thor has continuous nutrition, training support, hygiene supplies, and calming aids automatically while you invest once in heavy-duty gear to keep him safe, cool and mentally engaged.
